day14_to_day15.shape: Cash residual rises in all 5 while Committed Production residual contracts in all 5.

day18_to_day19.shape: Mixed across Battles; this is where the five trajectories cease sharing one simple component pattern.

day19_to_day20.shape: Cash residual rises in all 5; production behavior is mixed.

value_form_order: Day14->15: Cash-led expansion while Production contracts
Day17->18: second Cash-led expansion while Production contracts
Day18->20: trajectories become more mixed, but Cash growth remains prominent

endpoint_observation.note: This refers to growth accumulated from Day12 to Day20. Absolute Committed Production residual at Day20 is still larger than absolute Cash residual in all five maps.

observed_shape: The largest Day12->20 amplification phase is not a single monotonic Cash or Production process.
Across all five Battles, residual growth alternates between Production-led and Cash-led phases.
The strongest common Production-led jump is Day13->14.
The clearest common Cash-led response-shaped interval is Day14->15, where Cash residual rises while Production residual falls in all five.
A similar Production-led then Cash-led sequence repeats around Day16->18.
By Day20, cumulative Cash-residual growth since Day12 exceeds cumulative Production-residual growth in all five cases, although the absolute Production residual remains larger.
This establishes a repeated value-form sequence, not a causal conversion from Production to Cash.
boundary: All statements are descriptive of residual value forms.
Production contraction concurrent with Cash growth is not asserted to be causal conversion.
No Action, mechanism, Representation, Evaluation, Direction, Candidate, or policy mutation is inferred.
The next layer should remain public-world-side and ask which realized-output / productive-State changes coincide with the repeated Production-led and Cash-led intervals.
